title: SQL ALL Operator
text:
SQL
ALL Operator



The SQL ALL Operator

The
ALL
operator is used to compare a value
to every value returned by a subquery.

The
ALL
operator evaluates to TRUE if

every value
in the subquery result-set meet the condition.

The
ALL
operator is typically used with

WHERE
and
HAVING
statements.

ALL Syntax

SELECT
column_name(s)

FROM
table_name

WHERE

column_name operator
ALL (
subquery
);

Note:
The
operator
must be a standard comparison
operator (=, <>, !=, >, >=, <, or <=).
